title: Puzzles and games of skill stories vs music stories on points
question: Does a story about puzzles and games of skill get more points than a story about music?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about puzzles and games of skill gets more points than a story about music.
expect: If true, points per story for puzzles and games of skill stories should be at least 1.5x the value for music stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, puzzles and games of skill against music

group_a.label: Puzzles and games of skill stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h365 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h365 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
